# RxSynapse

> RxSynapse is a real-time options intelligence and smart money tracking platform for Indian markets, delivered via Telegram bot and web dashboard. Formerly known as RxFlow.

The platform provides real-time unusual options activity alerts for NSE — NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, FINNIFTY, MIDCPNIFTY, and top stocks. It detects volume spikes, open interest changes, and aggressive buying/selling; tracks smart money via daily FII/DII flows, bulk deals, and block deals. Users receive alerts on Telegram (@rxflow_alerts_bot) with severity filtering and outcome tracking.
